        (∑ w : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p) → RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1),

              RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.residualTupleWeight cuts A a w * F w
            else 0) /
          ∑ w : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p) → RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1),
            if RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleHistoryConstraint cuts p ω j w ∧ ∀ q ∈ A, w q = a q then
              RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.residualTupleWeight cuts A a w
            else 0

name: RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleWords_event
type:
∀ {k n L m : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n L) (e : Fin m ↪ Fin n) (B : (Fin m → RiffleUpperV2.Word k L) → Prop),
  (RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      B (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleWords e ω)) =
    ∑ w : Fin m → RiffleUpperV2.Word k L, if B w then RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleWeight cuts w else 0

name: RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.selectedDigitCount_split
type:
∀ {k L r : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin r)) (w : Fin r → RiffleUpperV2.Word k L) (j : Fin L) (d : Fin k),
  RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.selectedDigitCount Finset.univ w j d =
    RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.selectedDigitCount A w j d +
      RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.selectedDigitCount (Finset.univ \ A) w j d

name: RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.selectedDigitCount_le_cut
type:
∀ {k n L r : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n L) (e : Fin r ↪ Fin n) (A : Finset (Fin r))
  (a : Fin r → RiffleUpperV2.Word k L) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
  (∀ q ∈ A, RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleWords e ω q = a q) →
    ∀ (j : Fin L) (d : Fin k), RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.selectedDigitCount A a j d ≤ cuts.count j d

name: _private.RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.SortedHistory.0.RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cumulative_eq._simp_1_1
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.sorted_history_iff
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [Fintype α] [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ} (f g : Fin n → α),
  Monotone f →
    Monotone g →
      ∀ (j : Fin n),
        (∀ (r : Fin n), ↑r < ↑j + 1 → g r = f r) ↔
          (∀ a < f j, RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleCount g a = RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.observedCount f (↑j + 1) a) ∧
            RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.observedCount f (↑j + 1) (f j) ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleCount g (f j)
